title: 1390 Super Duke R EVO (Urban Commuter)
description: Representing KTM's prowess in the Hyper Naked Roadster class, the KTM 1390 Super Duke R EVO (Urban Commuter) is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
